title: Implement setup codex command
summary: CLI command for Codex MCP setup
description: Implement the `agent-plan setup codex` subcommand in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts. Add it to the CLI help, implement the configuration generator, and ensure it writes/prints a Codex-compatible MCP server block. Reuse existing scope helpers and package resolution logic from setup-claude-code. Verify via build and a smoke test.

tasks.title: Add agent-plan setup codex command
tasks.description:
Add the `setup codex` subcommand to packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts. The command should generate a Codex MCP server configuration block using `npx agent-plan mcp` and write it to the project-local `.codex/mcp.json` (or print it). Mirror the scope flags (`--user`, `--project`, `--force`, `--local`) and package resolution logic from `setup claude-code`. Update help text. Verify build and type-check pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented `agent-plan setup codex` in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts. The command writes a Codex/Copilot CLI MCP server config to `.codex/mcp.json` (project default) or `~/.codex/mcp.json` (with --user), supporting --force and --local flags. Updated usage/help text. Verified build, typecheck, and a local smoke test. Committed to `next` and bumped prerelease channel to 0.2.19-next.18; publish.yml is now publishing to npm with dist-tag `next`.

tasks.title: Extract shared SortControl and add sorting to feature/phase detail pages
tasks.description:
Implement sorting controls for feature-detail (phases) and phase-detail (tasks) and update the row color treatment. Extract SortControl from work-tree.tsx into components/ui/sort-control.tsx; export compareEntities from lib/dashboard-tree.ts. Use search params (?sort=priority&dir=asc) for state. Apply sorting via useMemo before filtering. Replace the surface-card + statusSurfaceClass wrapper in FeatureRow/PhaseRow/TaskRow with the shared StatusItem component (variant="surface") so detail-page rows share the same DISPLAY_STATUS_TOKENS color map as the Work Tree. Build and type-check must pass. Do NOT commit or push without explicit user approval.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented SortControl component in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/sort-control.tsx; exported compareEntities from packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-tree.ts; added sorting via search params (?sort=&dir=) to feature-detail (phases) and phase-detail (tasks) routes; unified row color treatment by wrapping FeatureRow/PhaseRow/TaskRow with shared StatusItem component. Build and type-check pass.
